en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a religious relic or mummified saint, enshrined in an ornate, glass-fronted case with a domed crown and cross at the top. The figure is dressed in elaborate ecclesiastical garments. Two angelic faces are depicted floating in the upper corners. Greek text is visible on the wall behind the shrine, and there is a photo credit or publisher's mark at the bottom in Greek script.
